text: Driver actions before the first publication-gates run. (1) At the seed base, make check-web-editions-current failed on the unrelated Claude theology/angelology draft (declared eligible, on release hold, commented-out \input lines, no tracked web edition), so this gate could not pass. The driver fixed the converter's matching of commented-out \input (separate commit d8c32cf92, regression test) and merged origin/main at af0929127 (merge 7c5faf256), where that leaf is published and declared conditional. None of the 230 paths main changed is among the 2,064 paths sealed into this run's accepted reviews, and main's converter reproduces the reviewed web Markdown a8b494c5 byte for byte. The six conflicted derived records (release manifest and rights mirror, Claude publication inventory, family ledger, document catalogue, source projection index) were regenerated with their owning tools and the install stage's five release bindings re-recorded, scoped. (2) The host Python carries Markdown 3.11 while requirements-public-alpha.txt pins 3.10.3; the gate is run with a scratch venv built from requirements-public-alpha.txt and requirements-tools.txt first on PATH, the environment the generate-web, web-review and install-publication workers used. No sealed input, reviewed PDF or reviewed web byte changed.
